exemptions.surface: org-kernel/kernel.py direct crossing entrypoints (publish_packet, publish_ecosystem_message, publish_ecosystem_from_directory, ingest_frame, consume_addressed_frames, consume_and_respond), shared kernel contract at semantic parity with StegVerse-org/.github org-kernel (supplied mesh only, node_store seam)
exemptions.why_manifest_bound_state_transition_is_n: The shared kernel publishes and consumes crossings without appending repository or organization receipts. SV-LLM keeps the shared kernel contract and does not add an SV-LLM-only ledger path to it; every SV-LLM crossing is made through org-runtime/crossing.py, which records each disposition on both ledgers. The kernel's own entrypoints remain callable directly (only with a supplied mesh) and would bypass that record.
exemptions.required_evidence_or_repair: Shared kernel records every crossing disposition on the repository and organization ledgers (or exposes a ledger hook), released in the canonical org-kernel and adopted here; then this exemption is removed.
exemptions.next_attempt: On the next canonical org-kernel release
